lines.en: label yumispecial40:
scene familyreunion1
: The fuck are you smiling for? You think that just because I’ve decided to say a few words to you means I’m gonna just let you back into my life?
lines.zh: : 你他妈笑什么？你以为我决定跟你说几句话，就代表我要让你回到我的人生里了？

lines.en: : If it weren’t for you putting your filthy fucking hands all over the dude my best friend likes for...whatever fucking weird reason she likes him for, I would have just kept walking.
lines.zh: : 要不是你把你那双脏手往我最好的朋友喜欢的男人身上乱放——她到底为什么喜欢他我也不懂——我早就直接走过去了。

lines.en: scene familyreunion2
: Course you would have. Just like you did back at Tojo’s.
lines.zh: : 你当然会。就像你之前在 Tojo's 那次一样。

lines.en: : I know it must be exhausting coming to terms with how I somehow managed to stay alive all these years, but would it kill you to at least {i}pretend{/i} to be happy to see me?
lines.zh: : 我知道，接受我这些年居然一直活着这件事肯定很累，但你{i}装{/i}一下见到我高兴会死吗？

lines.en: : Would it kill {i}you{/i} to stop fucking trying to...reconcile with me or whatever the fuck this is?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}他妈别再想……跟我修复关系还是什么鬼的，会死吗？

lines.en: : Reconcile? Your teacher the one helpin’ you learn big words like that?
lines.zh: : 修复关系？是你老师教你这种大词的？

lines.en: : Maybe. Just because {i}you{/i} decided to drop out of school doesn’t mean I’m going to follow in your footsteps.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。{i}你{/i}决定辍学，不代表我就要跟着你的脚步走。

lines.en: scene familyreunion3
: Good. I’m not sayin’ you should.
lines.zh: : 很好。我没说你该那样。

lines.en: : I’m glad you’re actually out there makin’ an effort and shit. Damn impressive for someone constantly running from the shadow of her mother.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你真的在外面努力什么的。对一个一直在逃离母亲阴影的人来说，真是了不起。

lines.en: : Would be a hell of a lot easier if that “shadow” wasn’t behind nearly every fucking corner I round lately.
lines.zh: : 要是那个「阴影」最近没在我拐过的几乎每个角落等着，那就轻松多了。

lines.en: : How hard have you been trying to see me? I feel like I can’t go ten minutes without Sensei or...anyone else fuckin’ bringing you up. Why now?
lines.zh: : 你到底多想见我？我感觉不到十分钟就会有老师或者……别的什么人他妈提起你。为什么是现在？

lines.en: : If you’re looking for drug money, go to Dad. Not me. I won’t take shit from him. I’m tryin’ to make it on my own.
lines.zh: : 你要是来要毒资，去找爸。别找我。我不会要他的东西。我在试着靠自己活下去。

lines.en: : I don’t need drug money, Yumi. I’m clean now.
lines.zh: : 我不是来要毒资的，Yumi。我现在戒了。

lines.en: : Yeah? For how many hours?
lines.zh: : 是吗？戒了几个小时了？

lines.en: scene familyreunion4
: Hey, how about we take a trip to the counter together? Maybe we can buy you a fucking cupcake or something to celebrate half a day sober!
lines.zh: : 嘿，要不我们去柜台那儿？也许可以给你买个该死的纸杯蛋糕什么的，庆祝你清醒了半天！

lines.en: : It’ll be just like the old days...when we’d come down to places just like this so you could buy cigarettes or booze to keep yourself occupied while I tried to learn how to read.
lines.zh: : 就跟以前一样……我们一起来这种地方，你买烟买酒好让自己有事儿干，而我则试着学着认字。

lines.en: : Doesn’t that sound fun, {i}Yuki?{/i}
lines.zh: : 听起来是不是很有意思，{i}Yuki{/i}？

lines.en: scene familyreunion5
: You can still call me Mom, you know.
lines.zh: : 你还是可以叫我妈的，知道吗。

lines.en: : Why would I?! Apart from the fuckin' ramen place, I can’t even remember the last time I saw you!
lines.zh: : 我凭什么？！除了在拉面店那次，我都记不清上次见你是什么时候了！

lines.en: : And half of the times I {i}do{/i} remember, you’re passed the fuck out with a needle sticking out of your arm!
lines.zh: : 而且我{i}记得{/i}的那些次里，有一半你都他妈昏死过去，胳膊上还插着针头！

lines.en: : Why the absolute {i}fuck{/i} would I call you “Mom?!” That’s a title you have to work for!
lines.zh: : 我{i}他妈{/i}凭什么要叫你「妈」？！那个称呼是要靠努力挣来的！

lines.en: scene familyreunion6
: Well then let me fucking {i}work{/i} for it, Yumi! You really think I’ve been trying so hard to see how you’re doing just because I need drug money?!
lines.zh: : 那就让我他妈去{i}挣{/i}啊，Yumi！你真以为我这么想了解你的近况，只是为了要毒资？！

lines.en: : Why the fuck do you think I’m still in Kumon-mi in the first place?
lines.zh: : 你以为我他妈为什么还留在 Kumon-mi？

lines.en: : Beats me. Probably got stuck inside before they closed the place off.
lines.zh: : 谁知道。大概是在封城之前就被困在里面了。

lines.en: : And knowing you, chances are you’ve burned all the bridges you need to keep yourself on your own two feet. Or what’s left of them, at least.
lines.zh: : 而且按你的个性，能让自己站稳的桥你大概早烧光了。至少剩下的那些是烧光了。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m a shitty person, and an even worse mother. And I’ve done a lot of stuff that I wish I never did. But I’m still a fucking person.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我是个烂人，更是个烂母亲。我做过很多希望自己从没做过的事。但我他妈还是个人。

lines.en: : I’m not asking for your help or forgiveness or any of that bullshit because I know full well that I don’t deserve it. Hell, I don’t even need to be a part of your life if you don’t want me to.
lines.zh: : 我不是来求你帮忙或者求你原谅什么的，因为我清楚自己不配。见鬼，你要是不想，我甚至不一定要出现在你的人生里。

lines.en: : But to have my...entire existence be ignored by my own daughter is just-
lines.zh: : 可让自己的亲生女儿无视我的……整个存在，这实在是——

lines.en: scene familyreunion7
: Just what?! Unfair?!
lines.zh: : 是什么？！不公平吗？！

lines.en: : You know what’s unfair, Yuki?! Growing up without a mom!
lines.zh: : 你知道什么才叫不公平吗，Yuki？！在没有妈的环境里长大！

lines.en: : At least if you would have fucking {i}died{/i} or something I could look back on you and try to dig up any of the “good” times we may have had!
lines.zh: : 你要是他妈{i}死{/i}了什么的，我至少还能回头想想，试着从过去里挖出一点我们也许有过的「美好」时光！

lines.en: : But, nope!
lines.zh: : 可是，没有！

lines.en: scene familyreunion8
: You were out...riding around on your little motorcycle...having a grand old time getting high and sucking dick for heroin while I was trying to figure out what it meant to be a normal girl.
lines.zh: : 你呢……骑着你那辆小摩托在外面兜风……嗨得不亦乐乎，为了海洛因去给别人口交，而我却在努力弄明白做一个普通女孩意味着什么。

lines.en: : The only reason I’m as fucked up and “rough around the edges” as I am now is because of you, {i}Yuki.{/i} You did this to me.
lines.zh: : 我现在会这么扭曲、这么「棱角分明」，全都是因为你，{i}Yuki{/i}。是你把我变成这样的。

lines.en: : So when I ignore your existence, it’s probably safe to assume that I’m doing it to protect myself.
lines.zh: : 所以当我无视你的存在时，大概可以肯定，我是在保护自己。

lines.en: : Got it?
lines.zh: : 明白了吗？

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: I got it.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: scene familyreunion9
: But I ain’t ever tried to dodge the blame for all that, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 但我从来没想过要推卸这些责任，Yumi。

lines.en: : In fact, all the shit I’ve been tryin’ to do lately is to prove how {i}sorry{/i} I am.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我最近做的所有事，都是想证明我有多{i}后悔{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, would you mind explaining to me how flirting with my fucking teacher in front of me is trying to prove how sorry you are? Because, to me, that just makes it look like you haven’t changed one bit.
lines.zh: : 不好意思，你能给我解释一下，当着我的面跟我老师调情，怎么就证明了你有多后悔？因为在我看来，这只能说明你一点都没变。

lines.en: : It was a joke, I don’t know. I just wanted you to say something. I didn’t really care what it was.
lines.zh: : 那是个玩笑，我不知道。我只是想让你说点什么。说什么都无所谓。

lines.en: scene familyreunion10
: Stop {i}wanting{/i} me to do anything and just go back to leaving me alone like you’ve done for the last...forever!
lines.zh: : 别再{i}指望{/i}我做任何事了，像你之前那样继续别管我就行……永远别管我！

lines.en: if yumiknows == True:
: I don’t want anything to do with you! And if you’re going to keep flirting with my friend’s boyfriend, do it in whatever fucking box you’re living in instead of in public!
lines.zh: : 我不想跟你有任何关系！你要是还想继续调戏我朋友的男朋友，就回你住的哪个该死的盒子里去调，别在大庭广众下！

lines.en: else:
: I don’t want anything to do with you! And if you’re going to keep flirting with my teacher, do it in whatever fucking box you’re living in instead of in public!
lines.zh: : 我不想跟你有任何关系！你要是还想继续跟我的老师调情，就回你住的哪个该死的盒子里去调，别在大庭广众下！

lines.en: : Did you like your present at least?
lines.zh: : 至少，你喜欢我送你的礼物吗？

lines.en: : I know it probably seemed like a fuckin’ slap in the face gettin’ something so small after so much time away, but that was really all I could afford with the money I have.
lines.zh: : 我知道，离开这么久才送你这么点东西，大概像是一记耳光，但我手头的钱真的只够买这些了。

lines.en: : I just wanted to do something for your birthday after missing the rest of ‘em.
lines.zh: : 我只是想在错过了你那么多个生日之后，为你做点什么。

lines.en: scene familyreunion11
: I’m surprised you’ve got enough brain cells left to even remember my birthday.
lines.zh: : 我很意外你居然还剩了足够的脑细胞记得我的生日。

lines.en: : As for the “present,” I loved it. Made a real satisfying sound when I tossed it into some fucking rich girl’s pond.
lines.zh: : 至于那份「礼物」，我可喜欢了。我把它扔进某个有钱丫头家的池塘时，那声音真叫一个爽。

lines.en: scene familyreunion12
: You...what?
lines.zh: : 你……什么？

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you were in the position to just be throwing away things that people give you-
lines.zh: : 我不知道你居然有资格随便扔掉别人送的东西——

lines.en: : Stay the fuck out of this, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这事你别插嘴，老师。

lines.en: : As if I’d accept a fucking consolation prize from this piece of shit.
lines.zh: : 我怎么可能收这个废物给的什么安慰奖。

lines.en: scene familyreunion13
: Heh.
: ...What?
: What reason could you possibly have to be laughing right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在到底有什么好笑的？

lines.en: : No real reason.
lines.zh: : 没什么特别的理由。

lines.en: : You just remind me a lot of myself when I was your age.
lines.zh: : 你只是让我想起了很多我像你这么大的时候的样子。

lines.en: scene familyreunion14
: Fuck you!
lines.zh: : 去你的！

lines.en: I looked away for a second, likely because even I get tired of staring at roadside car accidents, but even without looking, it’s easy to understand what just happened.
lines.zh: 我移开了视线一秒钟，大概是因为连我也会看腻路边的车祸，不过就算没看，也很容易明白刚才发生了什么。

lines.en: And I’m sure it’s the same thing that would have happened when Futaba was in the same exact scenario not too long ago.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，不久前 Futaba 处在完全相同的局面时，发生的事也一样。

lines.en: The last thing Yumi wants is to resemble her mother.
lines.zh: Yumi 最不想要的就是像她母亲。

lines.en: But, if that’s the case, it would probably be good for her to stop hitting people since I’m pretty sure that was just Yuki’s thing for a...very long time.
lines.zh: 不过既然如此，她大概最好别再动手打人了，因为我敢说打人这个爱好属于 Yuki，而且持续了……非常久。

lines.en: That aside, I think the time has come for me to step in.
lines.zh: 先不说这个，我想我是时候介入了。

lines.en: : Yumi, that’s-
lines.zh: : Yumi，那样——

lines.en: : Nah, let her go. It’s no big deal.
lines.zh: : 不，随她去。没什么大不了的。

lines.en: scene familyreunion15
: She hits like a bitch anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正她打人软绵绵的。

lines.en: : Wha-
: You know, maybe you’re {i}not{/i} my daughter after all. {i}My{/i} daughter would take her gloves off before slapping someone. It softens the blow.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，也许你根本{i}不是{/i}我女儿。{i}我{/i}女儿扇人之前会先把手套脱下来。那样能减轻力道。

lines.en: scene familyreunion16
: J-Just because your face is numb from being coked out of your mind doesn’t mean I hit like a bitch!
lines.zh: : 只、只是因为你的脸被可卡因搞麻了，不代表我打人软绵绵的！

lines.en: : Now get the fuck out of here before I do it again!
lines.zh: : 趁我还没再打一次，赶紧他妈滚出去！

lines.en: if yumiknows == True:
: I can’t. I’m still waiting for your “friend’s boyfriend” to choose what he wants for dinner since I owe him for helping me out.
lines.zh: : 不行。我还在等你「朋友的男朋友」挑今晚吃什么，毕竟我欠他一份人情。

lines.en: else:
: I can’t. I’m still waiting for your teacher to choose what he wants for dinner since I owe him for helping me out.
lines.zh: : 不行。我还在等你老师挑今晚吃什么，毕竟我欠他一份人情。

lines.en: scene familyreunion17
if yumiknows == True:
: Well maybe my {i}friend’s boyfriend{/i} should try to be a decent person for once in his life and {b}not stick his dick in my mother in exchange for a convenience store dinner!{/b}
lines.zh: : 那也许我{i}朋友的男朋友{/i}这辈子该试着当一回正派人，{b}别为了一顿便利店晚餐就把鸡巴伸进我妈身体里！{/b}

lines.en: else:
: Well maybe my teacher should try to be a decent person for once in his life and {b}not stick his dick in my mother in exchange for a convenience store dinner!{/b}
lines.zh: : 那也许我的老师这辈子该试着当一回正派人，{b}别为了一顿便利店晚餐就把鸡巴伸进我妈身体里！{/b}

lines.en: scene familyreunion18
: Hey. You can talk as much shit to me as you want, but that is your {i}teacher.{/i} You treat him with respect.
lines.zh: : 喂。你想怎么骂我都行，但那是你的{i}老师{/i}。你对他得有尊重。

lines.en: : Yuki, that’s really not-
lines.zh: : Yuki，这真的不——

lines.en: scene familyreunion19
: Huh. You know, maybe there’s a right way to slap someone with gloves on after all?
lines.zh: : 哈。你知道吗，也许戴着手套扇人也是有正确方法的？

lines.en: It’s clear that neither of these two have any interest in letting me interfere but, to be honest, I kind of expected as much.
lines.zh: 显然这两个人谁都不想让我插手，不过说实话，我多少也预料到了。

lines.en: Yumi’s already proven to be beyond reasoning with and Yuki is...well, {i}still{/i} not the best mother even when she’s trying to be.
lines.zh: Yumi 已经证明了自己是无法说理的，而 Yuki……嗯，就算她在努力，也{i}算不上{/i}是个好母亲。

lines.en: Her methods were definitely effective, though, as I don’t think I’ve ever seen Yumi this shell-shocked before- and I have literally forced my tongue down her throat.
lines.zh: 不过她的方法确实有效，因为我不记得自己见过 Yumi 这么震惊的样子——我可是真的把舌头伸进过她喉咙里。

lines.en: scene familyreunion20
: I haven’t heard an “I’m sorry, Sensei” yet.
lines.zh: : 我还没听到一句「对不起，老师」呢。

lines.en: : He did nothing wrong. When you have a problem with someone, you don’t bring other people into it. Got it?
lines.zh: : 他什么都没做错。跟谁有矛盾，就别把别人扯进来。明白吗？

lines.en: : I raised you better than that.
lines.zh: : 我教过你，不该这么没分寸。

lines.en: : I’m...sorry...
lines.zh: : 我……对不起……

lines.en: scene familyreunion21
: And you didn’t raise me at all, so my bad for not knowing where to properly direct my anger.
lines.zh: : 而且你根本没养过我，所以我不知道该把怒气往哪儿发，怪我咯。

lines.en: : Hitting your daughter in public, though? That’s low.
lines.zh: : 不过当众打你女儿？这就有点下作了。

lines.en: : What, and hitting your mother isn’t? Don’t dish it out if you can’t take it, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 怎么，打你妈就不下作？Yumi，你既然敢出手，就得受得住。

lines.en: : You wanna act like an adult and grow up all by yourself? Fine. Go right ahead.
lines.zh: : 你想表现得像个大人，想自己长大？行。随你便。

lines.en: : But don’t go around accusing everyone of being against you when they’re just trying to help.
lines.zh: : 但别在别人只是想帮忙的时候，到处指责所有人都跟你作对。

lines.en: : If you’re that afraid of winding up like me, that’s the very least you can do.
lines.zh: : 你要是这么怕变成我这样，这可是你最起码能做的事。

lines.en: : I fucking hate you.
lines.zh: : 我他妈恨你。

lines.en: scene familyreunion22
: Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : You should hate me.
lines.zh: : 你该恨我。

lines.en: : If I were you, though, I’d go check and see if that present you tossed into the rich girl’s pond is still there.
lines.zh: : 不过我要是你，我会去看看你扔进那个有钱丫头池塘里的礼物还在不在。

lines.en: : There were enough gift cards in that to feed you for a week, probably. Two if you be cheap about it.
lines.zh: : 里面塞的礼品卡大概够你吃一个星期。省着点的话，两个星期都够。

lines.en: : Please...just...
lines.zh: : 求你了……别……

lines.en: : Just leave me alone...
lines.zh: : 别管我了……

lines.en: scene familyreunion23
Yumi exits the convenience store in a hurry without buying anything- and I think it’s strange that my mind gravitates to {i}that{/i} aspect of this situation rather than anything else.
lines.zh: Yumi 什么都没买就匆匆离开了便利店——而我觉得奇怪的是，我的注意力反而落在了{i}这个{/i}细节上，而不是别的什么。

lines.en: I guess watching her struggle to stay afloat has become so normal for me that I just chalk it up to a natural occurrence any time things go horribly for her.
lines.zh: 我想，看她苦苦挣扎已经成了我的日常，以至于每当她遇到糟糕的事，我都把它当成理所当然。

lines.en: I guess there are just some people born with horrible luck.
lines.zh: 我想，有些人就是天生运气差。

lines.en: And I guess they just all happened to be born in close proximity to me.
lines.zh: 而我想，他们碰巧都生在我身边。

lines.en: scene black
scene familyreunion24
: Well, that could have gone better.
lines.zh: : 唉，本来可以更好的。

lines.en: : You know, when Yumi arrived, I could have sworn that you were going to ease up on the flirting rather than just entirely lean into it.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，Yumi 来的时候，我本来敢打赌你会收敛一点，而不是变本加厉地调情。

lines.en: : Not the best idea looking back on it, but I’ve got a history of making shit decisions in the heat of the moment.
lines.zh: : 现在回头看确实不是什么好主意，不过我一向有在冲动时刻做出烂决定的前科。

lines.en: : You gonna follow her?
lines.zh: : 你要去追她吗？

lines.en: : What would I do if I did?
lines.zh: : 追上去又能做什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Teacher shit? Tell her everything’s gonna be okay and like, pat her on the back or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。老师该干的事？告诉她一切都会好起来，然后……拍拍她的背什么的？

lines.en: scene familyreunion25
: Cheering people up isn’t really one of my strong suits.
lines.zh: : 安慰人真不是我的强项。

lines.en: : Same here, but I’m sure you’ve probably figured that out in the last few minutes.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此，不过我想你在这几分钟里大概已经看出来了。

lines.en: : We’ll take a rain check on dinner for now.
lines.zh: : 晚饭就先欠着吧。

lines.en: : Go run after my piece of shit daughter and make her feel like {i}less{/i} of a piece of shit for popping out of me.
lines.zh: : 去追我那个废物女儿，让她别因为是从我肚子里爬出来的，就觉得自己也是个废物。

lines.en: : I’ll just go back to my {i}box{/i} and relapse or something since that’s clearly all I’m good for.
lines.zh: : 我就回我的{i}盒子{/i}去复吸什么的，反正我显然也就这点用处了。

lines.en: : Please don’t. You’re doing really well based on the zero experience I have of the drug-addicted version of you.
lines.zh: : 别这样。虽然我完全没见过你吸毒的样子，但就凭这一点，你已经做得很好了。

lines.en: scene familyreunion26
: I know. And I won’t.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我不会的。

lines.en: : Gonna take more than that to knock me on my ass again.
lines.zh: : 想再把我打趴下，光靠这点事可不够。

lines.en: : But, uhh...thanks again for showin’ up or whatever. Sorry it couldn’t end on a better note.
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……还是谢谢你过来什么的。抱歉没能有个更好的收场。

lines.en: : Bad shit really tends to just follow me around at times.
lines.zh: : 倒霉事有时候就是会一直跟着我。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : Same here.
lines.zh: : 我也一样。
